entries.purpose: Review evidence and data, audit an existing model, and prepare a constrained human experiment handoff.
entries.evidence_scope: Configuration import and missing-input preflight only; no new experiment or material claim.

entries.purpose: Trace sample evidence, verify monomer identity, review candidates and produce uncertainty-aware recommendation cards.
entries.evidence_scope: Configuration import and missing-input preflight only; no validated candidate or property prediction.

entries.purpose: Organize literature and experiment files for binder, silicon-anode, and sulfur-cathode comparisons.
entries.evidence_scope: Configuration import and missing-input preflight only; no binder performance result.

capabilities.boundary: Read permitted supplier and SDS documents; retain exact product identity, supplier, document version and source. Require authorized access when login is needed.
capabilities.acceptance: Check a known product document, a missing document and an ambiguous product name; verify the returned version and source.

capabilities.boundary: Reuse an available MCP or documented API; preserve query, date, sources and coverage gaps.
capabilities.acceptance: Known paper, empty result, pagination and bounded result count.

capabilities.boundary: Use submit/status/result for long extraction jobs and retain page/table locations.
capabilities.acceptance: Real permitted PDF, page and table spot-check, explicit failure state.

capabilities.boundary: Return source, CID, canonical structure and ambiguity; never infer a structure from a name alone.
capabilities.acceptance: Known compound, no match and ambiguous query.

capabilities.boundary: Use only when an authorized group library exists; otherwise keep a provenance file list.
capabilities.acceptance: Read a permitted item and preserve attachment/source metadata.

capabilities.boundary: Human-assisted export with calibration evidence; do not assume an unattended API.
capabilities.acceptance: Reopen the exported project and compare calibrated points with the source figure.

capabilities.boundary: Enable only after structures, force fields, protocol, budget and scientific acceptance criteria exist.
capabilities.acceptance: Real small case, invalid input, timeout/cancel, reconnect and domain-specific result assertion.

capabilities.boundary: Use local analysis nodes for cleaning, descriptors, modeling, validation, plotting and export.
capabilities.acceptance: Normal unit and integration tests for the analysis code.

publication_limits: The catalog contains no original research attachments, private paths, credentials, deployment addresses or proprietary installers.
Commercial YJK and ANSYS case materials are maintained separately and are not claimed as public examples here.
A verified protocol or workflow import does not establish a scientific conclusion.
